comparison.objective: Dry-fit and glue a broken mug handle according to an adhesive procedure.
comparison.physical_skill: Meter adhesive, align two fracture faces simultaneously, press, and avoid contamination.
comparison.success_condition: Dry fit precedes two thin beads; both ends are seated and pressed, tube returned, assembly released and undisturbed.
comparison.reason: Adhesive metering and dual-face repair do not test screw-and-jam-nut countertorque or functional retention through articulated cycles.
